snippet.title: My Friendly Neighborhood | Console Release Date Announcement
snippet.description:
My Friendly Neighborhood, the kooky survival horror adventure from John and Evan Szymanski and the team at DreadXP is coming to console and Game Pass! Grab your controller and your Rolodex (ask a boomer, they’ll know) and get ready to teach these puppets their ABCs by force on July 17th!
Store link: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/my-friendly-neighborhood/9mwv1mv9lwf4
Follow the dev: https://x.com/Ducky_Szymanski
Join the community: https://discord.gg/PX25QrbGrw
